items.title: Breaking: Former Cuban president Raul Castro indicted on murder charges in the US
items.description: The move is the latest escalation in Washington's pressure campaign against the island's communist government.

items.title: Labor burns political capital as tax reform backlash grows
items.description: In an already difficult post-budget week, Labor isn't being helped by some of its "friends". But it has won an important endorsement from one powerful voice.

items.title: WA gas users warn Labor not to repeat flaws in state reservation scheme
items.description: Western Australian gas users are urging the Albanese government to build stronger transparency and enforcement into its proposed national gas reserve scheme.

items.title: Pressure builds on new homes and inflation as costs go through the roof
items.description: Amid fast-rising prices — from materials craned in, to rubbish trucked out — a residential builder lists the costlier surcharges, levies and products hammering the construction industry and fuelling inflation.

items.title: With El Niño waiting in the wings what's in store for Australia's winter season?
items.description: The Bureau of Meteorology is forecasting winter to be unusually warm across the entire country as an El Niño climate pattern is increasingly likely to take hold.

items.title: 'We're not fleeing': The disappearing Pacific nation relocating its people to Australia
items.description: Tuvalu is building new land to hold back rising sea levels, but the majority of its people are applying to relocate to Australia. As they do, many are confronting a disturbing question.

items.title: Diphtheria is spreading in Australia and so is misinformation about it
items.description: Falsehoods about diphtheria are spreading online as a worsening outbreak of the disease affects Indigenous communities.

items.title: Inside the 'worst managed infrastructure project in Australian history'
items.description: The Inland Rail has had funding slashed and the project placed on pause but Everald Compton has a bottle of Penfolds Grange waiting and even if it takes him till the age of 100, he's determined to see it through.

items.title: Israeli minister taunts detained activists from Global Sumud Flotilla in video
items.description: Some of the detained activists were being pushed and dragged along the ground by Israeli forces while Itamar Ben-Gvir was taunting them.

items.title: Brothers of Bondi hero ordered to stay away from him after alleged threat
items.description: Two brothers of Ahmed Al Ahmed faced Bankstown Local Court over alleged verbal threats via the phone.

items.title: Last two bodies of Italian cave divers recovered
items.description: Finnish divers have recovered the remaining bodies of the divers that died in an underwater cave in the Maldives.

items.title: 'What I need right now isn't sympathy': 30yo Souths star retires after MND diagnosis
items.description: Rabbitohs and Maroons enforcer Jai Arrow announces he will step away from rugby league after being diagnosed with motor neurone disease.

items.title: San Diego shooters named Australia's worst mass murderer in online posts
items.description: Thousands of kilometres away, but the terrible connection to Australia is evident. ABC NEWS Verify looks at the inspiration behind the San Diego Islamic Centre murders.

items.title: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese meets family of Kumanjayi Little Baby
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese says Australia stands with the family of a five-year-old Aboriginal girl, whose body was found on the outskirts of Alice Springs last month.

items.title: Why renovating your outdoor area gives 'the best bang for your buck'
items.description: Adding a new kitchen or bathroom to your home can be expensive, but budget constraints don't mean you have to take home improvement off the table altogether.

items.title: Can 'Baby Yoda' get Star Wars fans back in the cinema?
items.description: Grogu (aka Baby Yoda) made The Mandalorian a hit on streaming, now Disney is looking to parlay that goodwill into ticket sales to the latest Star Wars cinematic release.

items.title: Think you know music and film? Let's see how well you score in this quiz
items.description: From Mozart to Max Richter, can you pick the classical music in these iconic films?

items.title: Putin's China visit looked like Trump's but couldn't have been more different
items.description: Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping agreed to a raft of deals in front of invited press less than a week after Donald Trump left China's capital with no confirmed deals.

items.title: Banks, telcos briefed on threat of 'dangerous' AI model
items.description: A new generation of AI models deemed "too dangerous" for public release is driving Australia's efforts to lure top AI companies to establish a major presence in the country.

items.title: Australia's costliest disaster recovery program fails to deliver a single home
items.description: A new report finds a disaster recovery program set up after the devastating 2022 floods in northern NSW is yet to deliver any of the homes it promised.

items.title: Truck torn in half after collision with train at level crossing, six injured
items.description: Two toddlers and four women are injured after a train collided with a truck at a level crossing in Perth's east.

items.title: Death of Peter Hollingworth sparks difficult feelings for abuse victim
items.description: Former governor-general Peter Hollingworth, who resigned over his handling of child abuse in the church, died in Melbourne on Tuesday at the age of 91.

items.title: Core Lithium restarts Northern Territory mine as price rallies
items.description: Core Lithium has restarted mining at its project near Darwin as prices surge close to $4,200 a tonne.

items.title: Alcaraz injury woes deepen, former champion out of Wimbledon
items.description: Carlos Alcaraz will miss Wimbledon as he continues his rehab from a wrist injury that has already ruled him out of the French Open.

items.title: Luai and Tigers headline NRL's Las Vegas quartet for 2027 season-openers
items.description: Jarome Luai will begin his final season with the Wests Tigers in Las Vegas, with the NRL unveiling its teams for next year's season-openers.
